correctness.rationale: Classical 2-variable truth-functional formulas define all 16 subsets of four valuations. Under System C, closure under right weakening and conjunction makes each antecedent theory determined by a smallest chosen set f(A)⊆A; Cut/Cautious Monotonicity yield outcast f(A)⊆B⊆A ⇒ f(B)=f(A), and conversely contraction+outcast verify the axioms. System P Or is equivalent to f(A∪B)⊆f(A)∪f(B), equivalently heredity. The audited C++ enumerator extends f(A) by increasing mask cardinality with an exact outcast guard; a distinct top-down forced-interval recursion is also mathematically exhaustive. A separately written and compiled C++ top-down propagation implementation independently returned C=336852, P=596 and permutation fixed counts C [336852,3312,484,141,20], P [596,56,16,8,2]. Burnside division by 24 gives 14976 and 44 orbits under all 4-atom Boolean algebra automorphisms. These are exhaustive finite-domain proofs, not sampled evidence.
